_comment: Hostname-keyed brand configuration. This file controls presentation only — name, logo, domain, metadata, structured data, contact wording, canonical URL, and analytics attribution. It must never be read by, or wired into, any fare/pricing/distance/security logic. functions/_middleware.js is the only consumer of this file.
